meaning_and_boundary: The mechanism is reported within the coded source scope. A proposal can be Reported without being implemented.
The source explicitly states absence of the mechanism within the relevant scope.
Concrete construction or execution evidence supports implementation of this mechanism.
Mechanism-specific testing, trigger/error analysis or systematic qualitative investigation supports empirical evaluation; a with/without comparison is not mandatory.
The mechanism was explicitly enabled in the evaluated configuration. Triggering on a particular occasion is not required.
Evidence links the mechanism to actual clinical or business operation. Clinical data or simulation alone do not establish this.
Explicit negative evidence for the particular field and scope; absence of affirmative evidence alone is insufficient.
The registered source review did not establish affirmative evidence for this field. This is not proof of absence, particularly outside the reviewed source scope.
A retained ambiguous judgment, distinct from an uncompleted extraction. Exporting it does not independently validate the historical adjudication.
The field is inapplicable with an explicit rationale. It is not inferred from a prototype, a missing mechanism description or another field.
An unavailable coding value, not a negative or zero. There are no blank status values in this export.
The original summary table records agreement between original reviewer values. The original ratings are not included or changed here.
A historical status label retained from the original summary table, not a new certification of evidence quality.
English rendering of the label in the original summary table for an integrated source judgment.
English rendering of the label in the original summary table for accepted handling.
The original summary table records application of the failure/retry-limit boundary rule. See the previously recorded source-review notes.
A historical rule-repair label. This export does not treat the label alone as scientific adjudication.
The source coding records a safety-related result in this category. Reporting a control or discussing a risk alone does not establish an evaluated safety outcome.
The source explicitly states that this outcome category was not evaluated. This is distinct from Not reported.
No qualifying evaluated outcome was identified within the registered reviewed source domain. This does not prove absence beyond that source domain.
The retained outcome-coverage classification is ambiguous.
The outcome category is inapplicable with a documented rationale. No such value occurs in the exported safety-outcome matrix.
